invariants.rationale: Accessing 'style' is needed within the method, so it is likely expected to be non-null at method entry.
If 'style.up' is not null, calling 'getMinHeight()' should not be negative, based on usual UI component conventions.
Similarly, 'style.down.getMinHeight()' should be non-negative if 'style.down' is not null.
Likewise, 'style.checked.getMinHeight()' should be non-negative if 'style.checked' is not null.
